claims.claim: The Pi package declares one extension entrypoint plus the bundled skill roots.
The `/caveman` command reports status, saves a default, changes the session mode, and rejects unsupported modes.
The extension exposes aliases for commit, review, help, and compression skills.
The extension handles explicit stop phrases, restores the latest session mode, and adds active-mode instructions before each agent run.
Default-mode resolution checks the environment, then the user config file, then the full-mode fallback.
The communication skill defines six intensity variants and requires technical terms, code blocks, and quoted errors to remain exact.
The skill restores normal prose for security warnings, irreversible confirmations, and instructions where compressed ordering could be misunderstood.
